title: ampelocissus heracleifolia
intro: Ampelocissus heracleifolia, commonly known as the Climbing Grape, is a species of flowering plant in the grape family. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, and it is valued for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Ampelocissus heracleifolia include reducing fever, alleviating pain, and improving digestive health. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
